name: CUDA C++ Memory Model
description: The host/device-coherent, C++-style scoped memory model exposed by CUDA since version 9 (cuda::atomic with thread-scope template parameters). It mirrors the C++11 atomics interface and is layered on, and lowered to, the PTX memory model.

catSupport.note: The C++-style scoped surface is layered on PTX's axiomatic model, so a cat rendering would follow PTX's; none is published at the CUDA level.
